description:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates, with a strong focus on Swedish municipalities, schools, public-sector organizations, and professionals. Browse templates, inspect individual prompts, and discover relevant prompt packages directly through ChatGPT.

The published connector provides read-only access to Promptbanken’s open catalog. No personal or confidential user data is sent to or stored by the Promptbanken server.

resources.name: Kontrollera tjänstens status
resources.description: Return lightweight service status without loading prompt text.

resources.name: Hämta routing- och integritetsregler
resources.description: Return instructions for client-side skill routing without sending user text to the MCP server.

resources.name: Lista publicerade promptmallar
resources.description: List the full Promptbanken template catalog. The catalog is open -- no plan or key required; full prompt text is always included. Pass context_keys to combine profile variants. The server never renders a finished prompt -- each template carries raw prompt_text plus parameter_schema, default_bindings and binding_overrides; the client fills these in and renders the final text itself.

resources.name: Sök publicerade promptmallar
resources.description: Search the open Promptbanken template catalog without fetching every full prompt. Filter by free-text query (matched against title, syfte, tags, output format), area and/or risk_level. role ranks results toward relevant job functions -- it does not exclude templates from other areas. context_keys can combine profile variants. Returns lightweight summaries -- no prompt_text -- so use get_template(id) on a chosen result to fetch the full prompt.

role.description: Ranks results toward relevant job functions. Does not exclude templates from other areas.

resources.name: Hämta en publicerad promptmall
resources.description: Fetch one full template, including prompt_text, by its id (as returned by search_templates or list_templates). context_keys can combine profile variants and only select which stored variant is returned -- the server never assembles a finished prompt. The payload carries prompt_text, parameter_schema, default_bindings and binding_overrides; the client does all filling-in and rendering locally.

resources.name: Lista publicerade promptpaket
resources.description: List published Promptbanken packages/workflows. context_keys can combine profile variants; package_type filters when supplied. Each package carries raw intro_text plus parameter_schema, default_bindings and binding_overrides for the client to render itself.

resources.name: Hämta ett publicerat promptpaket
resources.description: Fetch one published package by slug, including the best matching profile variant for the supplied context_keys (variant selection only -- no server-side rendering). The payload carries raw intro_text, parameter_schema, default_bindings and binding_overrides; the client fills these in and renders the final text itself.

resources.name: Lista mallar i ett promptpaket
resources.description: List the prompts inside one published package, in sort order, using the best matching profile variant for the supplied context_keys (variant selection only -- no server-side rendering). Each prompt carries raw prompt_text, parameter_schema, default_bindings and binding_overrides; the client fills these in and renders the final text itself.

resources.name: Rekommendera promptpaket för en roll
resources.description: Recommend prompt packages (areas) suited to a job role. Pass a short role term (e.g. 'chef', 'kommunikator') -- if the calling client doesn't know the user's role, it should ask the user first. If the role isn't recognized, all packages are returned with role_recognized=false rather than an empty result.

release_notes:
1.2.1 — Initial release

Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for
municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. This
connector exposes nine public, read-only tools against the open catalog:

- health_check, get_client_routing_instructions — server status and client guidance
- list_templates, search_templates, get_template — browse, search, and retrieve full prompt templates
- list_packages, get_package, list_package_prompts — browse curated prompt packages and their contents
- recommend_packages — role-based package recommendations

No authentication is required. No personal or confidential data is sent to
or stored by the server -- the connector is metadata-only against a public,
read-only catalog

subtitle: Find and use prompt templates

test_cases.description: Search the catalog for a relevant municipal communication template.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public template summaries so the user can select one.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a template for informing staff about a service disruption.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a template after the user has selected it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected public prompt template for the user to use locally.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the full template with ID <selected template ID>.

test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available public packages with enough information to choose one.
test_cases.user_prompt: What public prompt packages are available?

test_cases.description: Inspect prompts included in a selected package.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the public prompts belonging to the selected package.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the prompts in the package <selected package ID>.

test_cases.description: Get package recommendations for a municipal role.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public package recommendations without changing catalog data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which prompt packages are relevant for an IT coordinator?

health_check.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
health_check.read_only_justification: Returns health status for the public catalog without creating or changing data.

get_client_routing_instructions.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.
get_client_routing_instructions.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
get_client_routing_instructions.read_only_justification: Returns client guidance for using the public catalog and does not modify data.

list_templates.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.
list_templates.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
list_templates.read_only_justification: Retrieves the open catalog of prompt templates without modifying it.

search_templates.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.
search_templates.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
search_templates.read_only_justification: Searches the open template catalog and returns matching summaries without changing data.

get_template.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.
get_template.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
get_template.read_only_justification: Retrieves one selected public prompt template without changing data.

list_packages.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.
list_packages.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
list_packages.read_only_justification: Retrieves available public prompt packages without creating or changing records.

get_package.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.
get_package.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
get_package.read_only_justification: Retrieves one selected public package without changing data.

list_package_prompts.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.
list_package_prompts.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
list_package_prompts.read_only_justification: Lists prompts in a selected public package without changing catalog data.

recommend_packages.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
recommend_packages.read_only_justification: Computes package recommendations from the public catalog without changing data.

sv-SE.description:
Promptbanken är ett öppet, kurerat bibliotek med färdiga promptmallar, med särskilt fokus på svenska kommuner, skolor, offentlig sektor och yrkesverksamma. Bläddra bland mallar, granska enskilda prompts och hitta relevanta promptpaket direkt via ChatGPT.

Den publicerade anslutningen ger skrivskyddad åtkomst till Promptbankens öppna katalog. Inga personuppgifter eller konfidentiella användaruppgifter skickas till eller lagras på Promptbankens server.
